name: Pidslukhanyi Veresen
source:
Marina’s signature strawberry shortcake could have been her ticket to making friends at the staff dinner – if she hadn’t left it at home. 

Facing odd coworkers, awkward situations, and a voice whispering she doesn’t belong, Marina must find a way to salvage the evening.
